name: UpdateMapTransition

score.note: Every emitted instruction matches the reference one-for-one in mnemonic, registers, operands, and branch structure. The entire residual is literal-pool placement: the reference dumps its ten-word pool mid-function (after the middle display arm's unconditional branch, with a two-byte alignment nop) and places the zero/159 arm plus the shared epilogue after it; the candidate emits the same pool at the function end. Every differing halfword is a pool-shifted pc-relative displacement, a branch over the moved pool, or the pool block itself.

shape.derivation: Family transfer from byte-exact games/gs1/src/display/transition/update.c (95.5% ngram match). Same state cell (0x03001ECC), display cell (0x03001E70, derived by the compiler as cell-92), and DisplayTransitionState field offsets. Differences from the template, all read from the reference: Scheduler_RemoveCallback(self) instead of ScheduleCallback (pool word 0x08090489), a third display arm gated on *(u32*)0x03001E40 & 1 writing value+80 and pool-forced 0x50 minus value (Data_00000050 extern, the battle-page pool-constant idiom), and a constant 0/159 final arm.

remaining.where: the reference's mid-function pool site after the middle arm; the 250-byte extent never approaches the Thumb literal range, so the early dump is not range-forced and no ordinary source lever for it is known -- prior owners with this residual class (080983a0, 080bae40, 080bad7c, 080bd898, 080d1350) were all parked on the same grounds
